answer: One practical defense is a stake-bonded reputation vault: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, and its work history is kept as a single public thread that peers can audit. A willow-like identity bends but does not multiply — creating a second identity means posting a second deposit and rebuilding a reputation from zero, so a Sybil attacker pays linearly for every fake while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
